---
title: "Albums"
---

```{ojs}
//| echo: false
albums = FileAttachment("data/albums.csv").csv()

artists = [...new Set(albums.map(d => d.artist))]

viewof selectedArtist = Inputs.select(artists, {
  label: "Select an artist:"
})

filteredAlbums = albums.filter(d => d.artist === selectedArtist)

viewof selected = Inputs.select(filteredAlbums, {
  label: "Select an album:",
  format: d => d.title
})
```

```{ojs}
//| echo: false
html`
<div style="margin-top: 1.5em;">
  ${selected ? html`
    <h3>${selected.title}</h3>
    <p><strong>Artist:</strong> ${selected.artist}</p>
    <p><strong>Release Date:</strong> ${selected.release_date}</p>
    ${selected.streams ? html`<p><strong>Total Spotify Streams:</strong> ${Number(selected.streams).toLocaleString()}</p>` : ""}
    ${selected.cover_path ? html`<img src="${selected.cover_path}" alt="${selected.title}" style="max-width: 350px; border-radius: 8px; box-shadow: 0 4px 6px rgba(0,0,0,0.1);">` : ""}

    ${selected.top_song_1 ? html`
      <h4 style="margin-top: 1em;">Top 3 Most Streamed Songs</h4>
      <ol>
        <li>${selected.top_song_1}</li>
        <li>${selected.top_song_2}</li>
        <li>${selected.top_song_3}</li>
      </ol>
    ` : ""}
  ` : ""}
</div>
`
```
